title: Cosmic Futures Laboratory: a numerical laboratory for conditional cosmological futures
description: Version 0.3.0 research software preview. This version restructures the numerical engine into layered modules (bit-identical results, about 2–3× faster), makes every output bit-identical on Linux and Windows with Node.js 24 through platform-independent powers, fixes 73 defects confirmed by an independent audit, locates cosmic events exactly on the continuous solution, adds the Gibbons–Hawking temperature and Nariai black-hole mass bounds, continues CPL dark-energy laws only where a proof applies (labelled literal extrapolations of the fit ansatz), and adds golden-master, property-based and coverage-gated tests, bounded HTTP API work and an extended independent SciPy reference. An interactive homogeneous FLRW simulator with adaptive numerical integration, conservative dark-matter-to-radiation transfers, conditional extreme-time asymptotes, astrophysical tracers, seeded uncertainty sampling, scientific references and reproducible exports. It does not calculate a unique actual cosmic fate, run an N-body model or fit an observational likelihood. Methodology, validation and limitations are documented in the archive.
